films.title: South Sudan
films.summary: The country at fourteen, told by the people who built it and the generation inheriting it, ahead of the first elections in over a decade.
films.posterAlt: Key art for the documentary South Sudan: The Land of Hope. A woman in beaded jewellery in profile against a river at sunset, a boat crossing behind her.

films.title: Congo
films.summary: Who owns what lies under the ground, who decides, and what the arrangement has cost the people living above it.
films.posterAlt: Key art for the documentary Congo: People, Resources, Tomorrow. A young man in profile against a river winding through dense forest.

films.title: Burkina Faso
films.summary: A country that keeps rewriting its own terms, and the artists, farmers and organisers holding the middle of it together.
films.posterAlt: Key art for the documentary Burkina Faso: Resilience, Culture, Change. A woman in a patterned headwrap in profile before a village and a granite outcrop.
